items.title: Brown representability produces a right adjoint of an exact functor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition states that an exact functor of triangulated categories from the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category which transforms direct sums into direct sums has an exact right adjoint (statement lines 3020-3026). The proof is a complete argument: for a fixed target object the author shows that the functor sending an object to the group of morphisms from its image under the given functor into that object is cohomological, because the given functor is exact and preserves direct sums, and represents it by an object of the derived category using Brown representability (proof lines 3028-3036); the criterion on representable functors then gives the right adjoint and the cited result gives its exactness (proof lines 3037-3041). The non-formal content is the identification of the functor to be represented. The claim is H2.
